summary: The payroll platform change carries payment integrity, privacy and recovery risks.
overallRiskRationale: The highest residual rating among the risks.
recommendationsSummary: Sign payment files, segregate approval duties and test the pay-run fallback.

risks.issueStatement: The pay-run fallback has not been tested.
risks.riskStatement: An untested fallback may delay the pay run after an outage.
risks.riskCause: The fallback procedure has never been exercised.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: No test evidence exists for the fallback.
risks.residualRatingRationale: A manual pay run remains possible.
risks.treatmentPlan: Test the pay-run fallback before go-live.

suggestedControls.rationale: Backup recovery testing covers the fallback.

risks.issueStatement: Zeta: bank details in the payment file can be read in transit.
risks.riskStatement: Unprotected payment files may disclose employees' bank details.
risks.riskCause: Payment files leave the platform unencrypted.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: Payment files carry personal and bank details.

risks.issueStatement: Alpha: payroll staff can change bank details without a second approval.
risks.riskStatement: A single person may redirect an employee's pay.
risks.potentialImpact: Pay redirected to a fraudulent account.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: Bank detail changes need no second approval.
risks.treatmentPlan: Require a second approval for bank detail changes.

suggestedControls.rationale: Segregation of duties needs a second approver.

risks.issueStatement: The payroll interface accepts unsigned payment files.
risks.riskStatement: An altered payment file may be processed as genuine.
risks.potentialImpact: Payments made to the wrong accounts.
risks.inherentRatingRationale: Unsigned payment files can be altered.
risks.residualRatingRationale: Signing is not yet in place.
risks.treatmentPlan: Sign payment files and verify signatures before processing.

suggestedControls.rationale: File integrity verification detects altered payment files.
